# Shell walkthrough, driven by synthetic input on a 1024x768 runner (client area 1008x729).
# Coordinates are read off the screenshots: toolbox "Button" at (37,621), below the toolbox search box at (100,60); the 640x480 root
# Canvas spans roughly x 200-728, y 147-627.
#
# The toolbox drag is the last step. It used to fail-fast the app with 0xC0000409 on the runner;
# the cause was the UI thread running in the multithreaded apartment (see Program.cs).
shot 01-start
# The toolbox search box narrows the list; clearing it brings every entry back.
click 100 60
type button
wait 800
shot 01a-toolbox-search
key ctrl+a
key delete
wait 800
shot 01b-toolbox-search-cleared
# Click-to-place a Button; it is selected and the property grid shows its properties.
click 37 621
click 330 420
wait 1500
shot 02-click-placed
# One Ctrl+Z removes it.
key ctrl+z
wait 1000
shot 03-undone
# Ctrl+Y puts it back.
key ctrl+y
wait 1000
shot 04-redone
# Select the canvas by clicking its empty interior: the property grid's enum rows read as names.
click 600 560
wait 1000
shot 05-canvas-selected
# Select All: place a second Button, select the canvas, Ctrl+A selects both buttons.
click 37 621
click 520 250
wait 1500
click 600 560
wait 500
key ctrl+a
wait 1000
shot 06-select-all
# Refresh: F5 rebuilds the surface; both buttons are still there, nothing selected.
key f5
wait 1500
shot 07-refreshed
# Delete: select both buttons, Delete removes both, one Ctrl+Z brings both back.
click 600 560
wait 500
key ctrl+a
wait 500
key delete
wait 1000
shot 08-deleted
key ctrl+z
wait 1000
shot 09-delete-undone
# XAML mode shows the serialized document.
click 342 711
wait 1500
shot 10-xaml-mode
# Replace the text by typing: Ctrl+A in the editor must select text, not design items.
click 460 350
key ctrl+a
type <Canvas xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"><Button Content="Typed" Canvas.Left="40" Canvas.Top="30"/></Canvas>
wait 500
shot 11-xaml-typed
# Back to Design: the typed button is on the surface at (40,30).
click 213 711
wait 1500
shot 12-design-from-xaml
# Selection follows a mode switch: select the typed button, switch to XAML and its start tag is
# selected in the editor; switch back and the button is selected on the surface again.
click 270 126
wait 800
click 342 711
wait 1500
shot 12a-xaml-shows-selection
click 213 711
wait 1500
shot 12b-design-keeps-selection
# Copy and paste through the real clipboard, with the typed button still selected: Ctrl+C,
# Ctrl+V adds a copy 10px right of and below it, selected; Ctrl+Z removes the copy; Ctrl+X cuts
# the original; Ctrl+V brings it back at +10.
# The Edit menu first, to see Cut/Copy/Paste's enabled state.
click 75 21
wait 800
screen 12b2-edit-menu
key escape
wait 500
key ctrl+c
wait 500
key ctrl+v
wait 1500
shot 12c-pasted
key ctrl+z
wait 1000
shot 12d-paste-undone
click 270 126
wait 500
key ctrl+x
wait 1000
shot 12e-cut
key ctrl+v
wait 1500
shot 12f-pasted-back
# Save: a new document has no path, so Ctrl+S opens the Save As picker, in Documents with the
# File name box focused and holding "New1". The XAML filter adds the extension.
key ctrl+s
wait 2500
screen 13-save-dialog
# Click the File name box first: once, the picker showed that box focused yet the typed keys
# never reached it, and nothing was saved. A click makes the picker the foreground window.
# (372,336) is the box at screen (380,367) less the client origin (8,31).
click 372 336
key ctrl+a
type walk
key enter
wait 2000
shot 14-saved
# Close the saved (clean) tab, then open the file again.
click 426 64
wait 1000
shot 15-closed
key ctrl+o
wait 2500
screen 16-open-dialog
# Keys typed into the Open picker on the runner land unpredictably (measured over three runs:
# lost, in the address bar, or refused there as "You can't open this location"), while mouse
# input lands. So open by mouse alone: the picker starts in Documents, which lists the
# "Visual Studio 18" folder first and walk.xaml second.
dblclick 260 188
wait 2500
shot 17-opened
# File > Open Recent lists walk.xaml, saved and then opened above.
click 24 21
wait 800
screen 17a-file-menu
click 70 119
wait 1000
screen 17b-open-recent
key escape
key escape
wait 500
# Error strip, last because it moves the mode bar up ~40px: break the XAML, switch to Design,
# and the strip lists the error.
click 342 711
wait 1500
click 460 350
key ctrl+end
type <Broken
click 213 711
wait 1500
shot 18-error-strip
# Drag-to-place, on a fresh document: drag Button from the toolbox and release on the canvas; it
# lands at the release point, selected. One Ctrl+Z removes it.
key ctrl+n
wait 2000
shot 19-before-drag
drag 37 621 400 400
wait 1500
shot 20-dragged
key ctrl+z
wait 1000
shot 21-drag-undone
# Command line: start the app again with the saved file as its argument. It opens as the only
# tab - the blank New1 the window starts with is closed, since nothing touched it.
launch {docs}\walk.xaml
wait 2000
shot 22-launched-with-file
# The list survived the relaunch: it is read back from the settings file.
click 24 21
wait 800
click 70 119
wait 1000
screen 22a-open-recent-after-relaunch
key escape
key escape
# A control library added at runtime: File > Add Controls Assembly..., then the sample library's
# .dll, which the workflow copied into Documents. The picker lists folders first - "Visual Studio
# 18", then the two sample libraries' layout folders - and then SampleBrokenTheme.dll, so
# SampleControls.dll is the fifth row.
click 24 21
wait 800
# A MenuFlyoutItem can take the first click as hover only (CLAUDE.md), and this one did.
click 70 152
wait 300
click 70 152
wait 2500
screen 23-add-assembly-dialog
dblclick 260 272
wait 3000
screen 24-assembly-added
# The search box finds the library's controls: SampleBadge first, then SampleCard.
click 100 60
key ctrl+a
type sample
wait 800
shot 25-toolbox-sample
# SampleBadge is built in code and should look like itself. SampleCard's look is in its
# library's Generic.xaml, which an unpackaged app has no resources.pri entry for: what it shows
# is the measurement (toolbox-assemblies spec Decision 7).
click 37 101
click 420 300
wait 1500
shot 26-badge-placed
click 37 141
click 420 420
wait 1500
shot 27-card-placed
# Save, and start again with the file: the library is loaded from the settings before the file
# opens, so both controls come back.
key ctrl+s
wait 1500
launch {docs}\walk.xaml
wait 3000
shot 28-relaunched-with-library
# A library whose theme merges a dictionary from ms-appx:///. Loaded as text, XamlReader.Load
# failed on it, and the app was measured surviving that (broken-theme measurement). Since the
# library-PRI change, the app resolves that ms-appx:/// from the library's .pri, so the theme
# loads and SampleBrokenCard renders red. SampleBrokenTheme.dll is the fourth row. If the app
# dies, the next step fails with its exit code (error.txt).
click 24 21
wait 800
click 70 152
wait 300
click 70 152
wait 2500
screen 29-add-broken-assembly-dialog
# The picker does not always start in Documents (one run opened it in Downloads), so pick
# Documents in its navigation pane first: (93,298) is the entry at screen (101,329) less the
# client origin (8,31).
click 93 298
wait 1500
screen 29a-picker-in-documents
dblclick 260 244
wait 3000
screen 30-broken-theme-reported
key escape
wait 1000
# Keep using the app for a while, so a deferred failure has the chance to surface.
click 100 60
key ctrl+a
type broken
wait 1500
shot 31-broken-control-listed
click 37 101
click 420 560
wait 3000
shot 32-broken-control-placed
key ctrl+z
wait 5000
shot 33-still-running
# A real NuGet library: CommunityToolkit's Segmented, from its package (a .dll and a .pri with the
# XAML embedded as .xbf, no XAML text). Remembered in the settings, loaded on the next launch; its
# template comes from its .pri through the app's resource manager (library-PRI spec).
toolboxassembly {home}\Toolkit\CommunityToolkit.WinUI.Controls.Segmented.dll
launch
wait 3000
shot 34-toolkit-loaded
key escape
wait 500
click 342 711
wait 1500
click 460 350
key ctrl+a
type <Canvas xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ct="using:CommunityToolkit.WinUI.Controls"><ct:Segmented Canvas.Left="40" Canvas.Top="40"><ct:SegmentedItem Content="One"/><ct:SegmentedItem Content="Two"/><ct:SegmentedItem Content="Three"/></ct:Segmented></Canvas>
wait 500
click 213 711
wait 3000
shot 35-segmented
